steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each pay figure is placed by its band and each group by its size against the minimum of five.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 pay figure is outside its band

findings.title: Pay figure outside its band with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason or correct the pay

findings.title: Group difference reported on a group below five
findings.fix: Merge the group or drop the figure

findings.title: Band with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the band

outcome.notChecked: Whether pay decisions are lawful in each jurisdiction.

example:

pros: Checks a pay figure outside its band with no reason, and a group difference reported on a group below the minimum size of 5.
cons: Not checked: Whether pay decisions are lawful in each jurisdiction.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-compensation-review skill on the records for this review.
